interface.shortDescription: Primary local execution, testing, and desktop bridge for heaven
interface.longDescription: Use the user's private Heaven Local Bridge as the default and exclusive path for computer work on heaven. Durable implementation lives on repository main; the heaven-bridge branch is the live queue/result transport only. Worker v3 supports structured filesystem operations, synchronous build/test commands, persistent dev-server sessions, process-tree termination, concurrent jobs, status/cancellation, output pagination, screenshots, desktop input/window control, controller checkpoints, local agent dispatch, and token-efficient local result compression. Version 0.5.0 adds a dedicated code/build/test execution skill so agents can validate repositories directly on heaven without Remote Desktop Commander.
